items.context:
Anyone else find fixed camera games cozy?
video, no description
items.text: Yes, I think so. When the camera is fixed there's nothing to fight with, you just look at the scene and settle in. Unpacking has that calm feeling for me.
items.verify: Проверь, что в Unpacking камера действительно фиксированная (я почти уверен, но не проверял).
